Markets.title: SC clears NSE settlement, paving way for mega IPO
Markets.summary: The Supreme Court validated the National Stock Exchange's settlement regarding co-location and dark fibre matters. This decision clears the path for the exchange to proceed with its massive initial public offering.

Markets.title: Centre sees no cost pain for RBI on dollar deluge
Markets.summary: The central government expects record foreign exchange inflows to cause minimal costs for the Reserve Bank of India because high US treasury interest rates will offset hedging expenses. While economists estimate these hedging costs could reach 36,000 crore rupees, the inflows will reduce the central bank's currency intervention expenses.

Markets.title: US stocks today: Dow soars 600 pts, S&P, Nasdaq over 1% as Fed governor Waller's remarks ease rate hike fears
Markets.summary: US stocks rallied over 1% on Thursday, with the Dow soaring 600 points after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller eased concerns about potential interest rate hikes. While major indexes and companies like Nvidia rose, Broadcom shares declined after its revenue forecast missed high artificial intelligence expectations.

Markets.title: Gold jumps 2% as Fed Governor Waller's comments temper rate hike bets
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over 2% after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated support for keeping interest rates steady if inflation continues to cool. This decline in rate hike expectations, along with lower Treasury yields and a weaker dollar, drove the surge in bullion as investors awaited upcoming US economic data.

Markets.title: Fed's Waller says safety premium for Treasuries is gone, pushing neutral rate higher
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that the loss of the safety premium on U.S. Treasuries is driving the neutral interest rate higher and keeping borrowing costs elevated. He also warned that the U.S. cannot grow its way out of its $40 trillion debt without reducing structural deficits.

Markets.title: US 30-year mortgage rate hits highest level in more than a year
Markets.summary: US 30-year mortgage rates have reached their highest level in over a year, increasing housing affordability challenges for buyers. This increase is driven by elevated Treasury yields resulting from inflation concerns, government borrowing, and Middle East tensions, even as Federal Reserve officials signal a potential pause on rate hikes.

Geo-Political.title: Trump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war support
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump suggested the United States might not support the UK regarding the Falkland Islands. He cited the UK's refusal to assist in his conflict with Iran as the reason.

Geo-Political.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
Geo-Political.summary: The Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) said shrapnel from a missile hit the ceremony and killed four people on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
Geo-Political.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warns that an upcoming severe El Niño weather pattern threatens global economic stability. Governments worldwide are actively preparing for the anticipated disruptions.

Geo-Political.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
Geo-Political.summary: A man lived for a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human organ. This milestone marks the longest reported survival time for a gene-edited pig kidney functioning inside a human body.

Geo-Political.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
Geo-Political.summary: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

Geo-Political.title: Around 2,000 fall ill in Indonesia after eating free school meals
Geo-Political.summary: Around 2,000 people in Indonesia fell ill after eating food provided through a new free school meal program. Authorities are now investigating the suspected outbreaks amid increasing criticism of the government scheme.

Data & Insights.title: Cong again questions India's ‘chest-thumping’ 7.8% GDP growth, demands answers on  ₹43 lakh crore revision
Data & Insights.summary: The Congress party has questioned the government's reported 7.8% GDP growth figure. It also demanded an explanation for the methodology used to reduce the estimated size of the economy by ₹43 lakh crore.

Data & Insights.title: Raghuram Rajan clarifies his stand on GDP: If growth is strong, why aren’t private investment, FDI and jobs rising?
Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan stated he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's GDP growth figures. However, he expressed confusion over why this reported growth has not led to increases in private investment, foreign direct investment, or job creation.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal calls for nationwide push to unlock export benefits under FTAs
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged a nationwide push to help businesses maximize benefits from India's free trade agreements. These nine trade pacts currently cover economies with a combined GDP of about $60 trillion.

Data & Insights.title: Neelkanth Mishra rejects base-revision concerns over 7.8% GDP growth, says, 'several indicators hard to manipulate'
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank's Neelkanth Mishra defended India's 7.8% GDP growth rate against accuracy concerns. He asserted that multiple economic indicators are difficult to manipulate, proving the growth is legitimate.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What is the confusion over GDP growth numbers?
Data & Insights.summary: Opposition parties and some experts are questioning the accuracy of the government's latest Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data. Mint analyzes these allegations to determine if the concerns regarding the growth numbers have any merit.

India.title: ISRO Successfully Launches GSLV F17 Rocket Carrying Imaging Satellite EOS-05
India.summary: ISRO successfully launched its GSLV F17 rocket carrying the EOS-05 imaging satellite from Sriharikota. The pre-dawn mission took place on Friday from the Indian spaceport.

India.title: India Ready To Extend "Any Help" To End Russia-Ukraine War: S Jaishankar
India.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that India is ready to provide assistance to help end the Russia-Ukraine war. During his visit, Jaishankar also met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to discuss strengthening bilateral cooperation.

India.title: Big Relief For Karnataka Teachers Suspended For Taking Part In RSS March
India.summary: Two suspended teachers from Karnataka's Yadgir district, Gururaj Joshi and Anna Saheb Deshmukh, received relief after being penalized for participating in an RSS march. The educators had previously faced suspension for taking part in the organization's event in Hunasagi taluk.

India.title: Neglected Ambulance Forces Kerala Tribals To Carry Sick Across Forest
India.summary: Locals in Kerala's tribal region are forced to carry sick people across the forest because the local ambulance is neglected and unusable. Residents urge authorities to resolve administrative delays and repair the vehicle to relieve their severe medical transport hardships.

India.title: Encounter Underway In J&K's Pirpanjal, 2 Terrorists Suspected To Be Hiding
India.summary: An encounter between security forces and suspected terrorists is underway in Jammu and Kashmir's Pirpanjal region. Police confirmed that counter-terrorism operations and an exchange of gunfire are currently taking place.

India.title: Black Flag Protest During Bhagwant Mann's Event Sparks Row; Majithia Slams AAP
India.summary: An anti-drug campaigner displayed a black cloth and raised slogans against the Punjab government during a Bhagwant Mann event. Police detained the protester, who subsequently alleged he was assaulted.

General.title: Farage senior aide filmed suggesting way to avoid donations law
General.summary: Channel 4 broadcasted footage of a senior Reform UK aide discussing ways to bypass political donation laws with an undercover reporter. The recording features senior figures from Nigel Farage's party talking with the purported donor.

General.summary: Sources indicate the controversial Jackdaw gas field off the coast of Aberdeen is set to be approved by the government within weeks. The project has advanced toward a final go-ahead, according to BBC understands.

General.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
General.summary: A genetically modified pig kidney functioned in a human body for a record 271 days. The patient received the xenotransplant while waiting for a human kidney.

General.title: British army told to stop non-essential training exercises to save money
General.summary: The British army has ordered units not preparing for deployment to reduce non-essential training exercises. This directive aims to cut costs amid mounting financial pressures.
